description: This file defines a React component for a GitHub repository search page. It manages search query, filters, sorting, pagination, fetching data from an API or generating mock data, and renders the search interface with various child components.

methods.name: SearchPage
methods.description: Main React functional component implementing the search page platform, managing state, effects, and rendering.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles search form submission, updates query and language state, resets page number.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Handles changes in sorting controls, updates sorting state and resets page number.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination control changes, updates page and pageSize state.

methods.name: fetchResults
methods.description: Performs the search request, uses API or falls back to mock data, processes and updates results, manages loading and error states.
